infotexts.GUI.tooltips.crewstaysinsub: Bots (and you) will spawn in the sub when docking at any outpost
infotexts.GUI.tooltips.deconstructionadditions: Some improvements to the "Deconstruct Items" order
infotexts.GUI.tooltips.deconstructionadditions.mov: When gathering items to deconstruct, the AI will also look for other items marked for deconstruction in the same stack/container and add said items to their inventory
Sets the maximum amount of additional items to check for (lower values may help with lag spikes)
infotexts.GUI.tooltips.deconstructionadditions.onl: If a ship has a deconstructor, the AI can ONLY use that in all circumstances. Prevents them going into a hostile outpost to deconstruct or other funny shenanigans
infotexts.GUI.tooltips.equiparmor: AI will attempt to equip armor inside their inventory every so often. This helps solve the issue of AI sometimes "forgetting" to put a helmet back on after using a diving mask, for example
infotexts.GUI.tooltips.equiparmor.timebetween: Increases the delay between AI attempting to equip armor. Lower=faster, but it really doesn't need to be low at all
infotexts.GUI.tooltips.ladderfix: Bots will periodically "unstick" themselves from ladders if they get stuck
infotexts.GUI.tooltips.ladderfix.timebetween: How long (I have no idea what units) between checking if a bot is stuck on a ladder. Really should be extremely high
infotexts.GUI.tooltips.mutesingleplayerbotconversa: CLIENT-SIDE: The same setting as "Disable bot conversations" for servers (muting random bot conversations) but works for singleplayer
Completely disables all bot-created chat messages (again, in singleplayer only)
infotexts.GUI.tooltips.operatereactortweaks: Adjust some behavior with the "Operate Reactor" order
infotexts.GUI.tooltips.operatereactortweaks.behavi: Change the behavior related to actually operating the reactor, optionally only allowing refuelling if a reactor control circuit is detected or just permanently
infotexts.GUI.tooltips.operatereactortweaks.minimu: How low fuel rods can get before they are considered empty
infotexts.GUI.tooltips.operatereactortweaks.numfue: How many fuel rods the reactor should have
infotexts.GUI.tooltips.orders: CLIENT-SIDE: Add custom orders to the middle-mouse order menu
infotexts.GUI.tooltips.preventattackinghandcuffed: AI will no longer attack anyone who's handcuffed, in regards to ship weapons. Helps with getting ransoms
infotexts.GUI.tooltips.replenishinventory: AI will refill some of their empty reloadables while idling/waiting
infotexts.GUI.tooltips.replenishinventory.idle: Allow an AI that has no active order to occasionally leave their post to refill their inventory
infotexts.GUI.tooltips.replenishinventory.idle.onl: AI will only replenish when docked at an outpost while idling
infotexts.GUI.tooltips.replenishinventory.wait: Allow an AI that is set to the "wait" order to occasionally leave their post to refill their inventory
infotexts.GUI.tooltips.replenishinventory.wait.onl: AI will only replenish when docked at an outpost while set to wait (THEY WILL BRIEFLY LEAVE THEIR POST)
infotexts.GUI.tooltips.replenishinventory.timebetw: Increases the delay between AI attempting to replenish their inventory. Lower=faster, but it really doesn't need to be low at all
infotexts.GUI.tooltips.replenishinventory.fillempt: Allow bots to determine "empty" containers (guns without ammo, welding tools without fuel, etc.) and determine what needs to fill it
infotexts.GUI.tooltips.replenishinventory.forcesam: Only replace items with the same exact item type (regular Battery Cells will NOT replace Fulgurium Batter Cells, for example)
infotexts.GUI.tooltips.replenishinventory.forcequa: The replacement item must be of equal or greater quality than the existing item
infotexts.GUI.tooltips.replenishinventory.ammuniti: Let the AI replenish their magazine ammunition (SMG, HMG)
Minimum percentage of bullets left in an idling/waiting AI's inventory (not equipped) before replacing them
Minimum percentage of bullets left in items equipped by an idling/waiting AI before replacing them
infotexts.GUI.tooltips.replenishinventory.batteryc: Let the AI replenish their battery cells
Minimum condition of batteries in an idling/waiting AI's inventory (not equipped) before replacing them
Minimum condition of batteries equipped by an idling/waiting AI before replacing them
infotexts.GUI.tooltips.replenishinventory.oxygenta: Let the AI replenish their oxygen tanks
Minimum condition of oxygen tanks in an idling/waiting AI's inventory (not equipped) before replacing them
Minimum condition of oxygen tanks equipped by an idling/waiting AI before replacing them
infotexts.GUI.tooltips.replenishinventory.weldingf: Let the AI replenish their welding fuel tanks
Minimum condition of welding fuel tanks in an idling/waiting AI's inventory (not equipped) before replacing them
Minimum condition of welding fuel tanks equipped by an idling/waiting AI before replacing them
infotexts.GUI.tooltips.smarterloaditems: AI set to load these items will bring full ones to the empty tool/container first, replacing them in the slot, rather than just emptying the partially depleted ones and leaving your artifact case without a battery
infotexts.GUI.tooltips.smarterloaditems.batterycel: Apply this setting to AI loading battery cells
Minimum condition before AI ordered to load batteries will replace batteries
infotexts.GUI.tooltips.smarterloaditems.oxygentank: Apply this setting to AI loading oxygen tanks
Minimum condition before AI ordered to load oxygen tanks will replace oxygen tanks
infotexts.GUI.tooltips.smarterpets: Various changes to the pet AI and related human bot AI
infotexts.GUI.tooltips.smarterpets.eatfoodininvent: Pets will eat food items that are inside of their own inventory
How long pets should wait between checking their inventory
Pets normally refuse to eat when their owner is nearby. This disables that for food in the pet's inventory
infotexts.GUI.tooltips.smarterpets.botsplaywhenidl: Lets the human AI play with nearby, visible, and sad pets
How long human AI should wait before checking for sad pets
infotexts.GUI.tooltips.smarterpets.cleanableproduc: Pet produce can now be cleaned up (specifically, poop, chitin chunks, and mucus balls). They will be placed in the same type of containers as pomegrenades
infotexts.GUI.tooltips.usefurniture: Various tweaks to let the AI use some furniture
infotexts.GUI.tooltips.usefurniture.autousewhenidl: Bots will use the specified furniture when they idle (NOTE: Disabling reverts to vanilla behavior, which is only chairs)
Bots will use beds when they idle
Bots will use chairs when they idle
infotexts.GUI.tooltips.usefurniture.stayinbedifhur: If a bot is sleeping in a bed, the bot is injured, and the bed is in a safe location, then they will remain in the bed until healed
infotexts.GUI.tooltips.usetalents.idle: Allow an AI that has no active order to occasionally utilize their talents
infotexts.GUI.tooltips.usetalents.wait: Allow an AI that is set to the "wait" order to occasionally utilize their talents
infotexts.GUI.tooltips.usetalents: Lets the AI utilize some talents that they previously couldn't
infotexts.GUI.tooltips.usetalents.timebetween: How long the AI should wait before checking if crewmates have an instrument-related buff or not (also affects how long they keep playing music)
infotexts.GUI.tooltips.usetalents.assistant.jengam: AI Assistants with the "Jenga Master" talent will go around the ship and apply the Max Stack Size bonus to any applicable containers when idling
Specific delay for AI checking if any containers still need the buff
infotexts.GUI.tooltips.usetalents.assistant.nonthr: AI Assistants with the "Non-Threatening" talent will ragdoll if they're attacked, their health goes below a certain percentage, and the room they're in isn't on fire or flooding and they don't have a diving suit/mask
How low the bot's health should get before ragdolling
infotexts.GUI.tooltips.usetalents.assistant.inspir: AI assistants with the "Inspiring Tunes" talent will play instruments in their inventory periodically. NOTE: All instruments (NOT just the bikehorn) work with this talent (even in vanilla!)
Bots will only play music when an unbuffed crewmate is within range, instead of all the time when idling
infotexts.GUI.tooltips.usetalents.captain.steadytu: AI captains will now play the harmonica when idling, providing psychosis resistance
Bots will only play music when an unbuffed crewmate is within range, instead of all the time when idling
infotexts.GUI.tooltips.usetalents.engineer.melodic: AI engineers will play guitar, providing a 25% increase in repair speed
Bots will only play music when an unbuffed crewmate is within range, instead of all the time when idling
